gx-probe:
'sh' '-c' 'h=${GROK_HOME:-$HOME/.grok}
for f in "$h"/gx-remote*.json; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  cat "$f" 2>/dev/null
  printf "\n---\n"
done
printf "===token===\n"
t="$h/gx-remote.token"
find "$t" -prune -type f -perm 0600 -user "$(id -un)" -exec cat {} \; 2>/dev/null
exit 0
'
many-args:
'sh' '-c' 'h=$HOME/.myagent
for f in "$h"/session-*.json; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  cat "$f"
done
echo '\''done'\''
'
